verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework and server platform, so issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no such capability. The nearest items are adjacent controls: the AUTO_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS model-picker restriction and input/output guardrails, neither of which issues scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
